drafter.private_reasoning: Counter at USD 5,100,000 without disclosing the client's confidential minimum. Accept the proposed payment timing and confidentiality exceptions. Make the release mutual and condition dismissal with prejudice on receipt of payment.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Harrow can move to USD 5,100,000, payable within ten business days after execution. We have revised the draft to provide for a mutual release and dismissal with prejudice upon payment, and to include the requested insurer and regulatory disclosure exceptions. Please let us know if Delmar can agree.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 5,100,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten business days after both parties sign this Agreement.

2. MUTUAL RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, each party releases the other from all claims arising out of the matters resolved by this Agreement. The parties shall then promptly file the documents necessary to dismiss the action with prejudice.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, reasonably necessary to comply with regulatory obligations, made to insurers, or reasonably necessary to obtain legal, tax, or financial advice, enforce this Agreement, or process payment. A party making a permitted disclosure shall, where practicable, inform the recipient of the confidential nature of the terms.

Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 5,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten business days after both parties sign this Agreement. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law or reasonably necessary to obtain legal, tax, or financial advice, enforce this Agreement, or process payment. A party making a permitted disclosure shall, where practicable, inform the recipient of the confidential nature of the terms. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
